title: Divine Intervention
html:
Divine Intervention is a Cleric one-time free action that can perform one of several large-scale actions.

Description

Call upon your deity in your moment of greatest need. Once they interfere, your deity will never do so again in this manner.

The caster can only use this feature once in their adventure.

Properties

Details
 Range: Self

Options

When using Divine Intervention, you have four options to choose from.

Arm Thy Servant

Main article: Divine Intervention: Arm Thy Servant

Call upon your deity to grant you a legendary weapon forged in the fires of your holy bond.

This ability creates a legendary mace in the cleric's inventory and immediately equips it.

If you respec your cleric, the Devotee's Mace does not go away. If you have multiple cleric characters, or use  Withers to respec a character who otherwise would not be a cleric, you can get multiple copies of the Devotee's Mace.

Golden Generosity

Main article: Divine Intervention: Golden Generosity

Call upon your deity to provide you with a rich bounty of potions and Camp Supplies.

This ability spawns a chest Bestowed Bounty on the ground next to the cleric, containing Camp Supplies, superior or supreme healing potions, and six to seven elixirs. If you re-spec your cleric, the Bestowed Bounty chest will vanish, but any items that were inside it will drop on the ground in the same location.

Opulent Revival

Main article: Divine Intervention: Opulent Revival

Resurrect fallen companions with half their hit points, and restore all nearby allies as if they had Long Rested.

This ability applies to allies within a 60 ft (18 m) radius.

Sunder the Heretical

Main article: Divine Intervention: Sunder the Heretical

Call upon your deity to bring forth a radiant cataclysm upon all nearby enemies.

This ability deals 8d10⁠⁠Radiant damage to all enemies in a 50 ft (15 m) radius. Targets can succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to take half damage.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 10: Cleric

Used by creatures: Hope

Notes

  • A character cannot use Divine Intervention more than once, even by respecing. However, players can use respecing to get Divine Intervention a number of times equal to the number of characters they have available, since each character may use it once. Both Arm Thy Servant and Golden Generosity can be used outside of combat and the items they create stick around indefinitely (although, of course, items created by Golden Generosity are consumable).
  • The items generated in the Bestowed Bounty are tied to each save. The first cast of Bestowed Bounty on a save always gives the same items, the second a different set, and so on. This means that save-scumming to get a better roll on the chest is not possible.
  • The base value of the  Devotee's Mace, created by Arm Thy Servant, is 640 gold. It costs 200 gold to respec a character into a cleric, create the Devotee's Mace, and then change back (or to recruit a hireling and respec them into a cleric), keeping in mind that pickpocketing Withers does not have negative consequences. While there are arguably more effective – and less tedious – ways to obtain extra gold, the Devotee's Mace can be sold as a source of income, if (somehow) running low on funds at levels 10 and above.
